notes_list.title: Match the Following
notes_list.basic_overview: Reaction names, reagents, substrates and products may be given in separate columns.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
Fast matching strategy: first identify unique signatures such as diazonium + CuCN = Sandmeyer nitrile; diazonium BF4− + heat = Balz–Schiemann; primary amide + Br2/base = Hofmann rearrangement; aldehyde + Ph3P=CHR = Wittig.

MECHANISM & STEPWISE EXPLANATION
The source describes the transformation as: Reaction names, reagents, substrates and products may be given in separate columns. The mechanism should be read as activation of the stated substrate, formation of the key reactive intermediate, the bond-making/bond-breaking event described by the reaction, and the stated work-up/product-forming step.

1. Activate the stated substrate with the listed reagent/conditions.
2. Generate the key reactive intermediate or electrophile/nucleophile implied by the reaction.
3. Carry out the characteristic bond-forming, bond-breaking or rearrangement step.
4. Complete proton transfer/work-up and verify the characteristic product.
